80418.subject: Metaplanet’s BTC Plot Twist
80418.body:
----------
_**Your Weekly Deep Dive into The World of Crypto**_

**October 7, 2026 · ****5 Min Read**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c58d9ad5-454a-493f-810b-d1af2bbcd7e5/image.png?t=1791352280)
Caption: _As of October 7, 2026  |  Sources: CoinGecko, Alternative.me, SoSoValue_

## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

Uptober showed up. Metaplanet staged the year's most dramatic treasury move by selling 10K BTC and buying 11K right back. A dormant whale moved $760M in Bitcoin twice in three days. The Philly Fed published an actual academic paper confirming minnows chase whales.

_**Let’s get into it...**_


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c53930f-b4d7-4e7d-baee-6a88bb56a6da/image.png?t=1781097813)
Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. Metaplanet's Great BTC Flip**

Metaplanet did something nobody expected in Q3: it sold 10,000 BTC and bought 11,000 right back. Net +1,000 BTC. The Japanese firm now holds 44,000 BTC (roughly $3.8B), the second-largest publicly listed BTC treasury behind Strategy.

CEO Simon Gerovich[ framed](https://x.com/gerovich/status/2107046348008874252) it as a liquidity demonstration. The firm also[ unveiled](https://contents.xj-storage.jp/xcontents/33500/0d0958ed/fc18/41fb/97c6/a44ab5c42f38/140120261005546253.pdf) a Net Interest Income Strategy, allocating 10-15% of assets to preferred stock issued by other BTC treasury companies.

**Whale Intel: **When Asia's biggest BTC treasury proves it can liquidate 10K coins and still come out net long, the "forced seller" thesis against treasury companies loses weight.

**👉 Read**[ Metaplanet's TSE Disclosure for Full Details](https://contents.xj-storage.jp/xcontents/33500/4b5f0c2e/ab52/4d40/9d89/e2aa6e3f3524/140120261005546274.pdf).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/edadfa1e-450e-4b0d-9f44-29807284aeec/image.jpeg?t=1791352339)
Caption: _Source: Metaplanet filing + Coindesk coverage, Oct 5, 2026_

### **2. Strategy Keeps Nibbling (334 BTC This Week)**

Strategy Inc.[ acquired](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001050446/000119312526413164/mstr-20261005.htm) 334 BTC for $28.7M at an average of $85,838.8 between Oct 1-4, per the latest 8-K. Total holdings sit at 848,000 BTC with a cost basis of $75,440.7. This is the smallest Strategy weekly buy in months. The more interesting number: Strategy also used $154.1M of USD Cash the same week to repurchase STRC preferred stock.

**Whale Intel: **When Strategy spends more on preferred buybacks than on BTC the same week, that is a signal about relative value, not conviction. Watch for a bigger BTC buy once STRC is repriced.
